headline: Maye's three picks open the door as Packers torch Patriots
takeaway: Drake Maye threw three first-half interceptions, the first on his opening pass, and Green Bay piled up 478 yards in a 45–27 rout at Gillette. It's the most points New England has allowed in a regular-season game since 1993.

sections.label: 1st quarter
sections.text: Xavier McKinney intercepted Maye's first pass and returned it to the New England 14, and two plays later Jordan Love scrambled in from 13 yards for a 7–0 lead. Love hit Matthew Golden for a 5-yard touchdown at 7:59 to make it 14–0. Green Bay lost Josh Jacobs (broken finger) and Ty'Ron Hopper (chest) in the quarter.

sections.label: 2nd quarter
sections.text: Trey Smack's 41-yard field goal made it 17–0 before Maye found Rhamondre Stevenson on a 30-yard touchdown. Maye threw two more interceptions in the quarter, and Kaleb Johnson's 2-yard run made it 24–7 before Efton Chism III caught an 8-yard touchdown with 2:37 left. Carlton Davis III and Ben Brown left with knee injuries.

sections.label: 3rd quarter
sections.text: Green Bay scored 18 straight: Love to Savion Williams for 10 yards (31–14), a 51-yard Smack field goal (34–14), then a 39-yard Love strike to Christian Watson after Isaiah McDuffie forced a Stevenson fumble, with Love running in the two-point try for 42–14. Stevenson left with a knee injury, and Maye hit Mack Hollins for a 22-yard score with 1:11 left.

sections.label: 4th quarter
sections.text: Smack added a 38-yard field goal for 45–21, and Corey Kiner ran in from 4 yards with 3:54 left; the two-point try failed. Will Campbell left with a knee injury.

performers.name: Drake Maye
performers.note: All three interceptions came before halftime, and he is now tied for the NFL lead with 11; he said he 'wasn't good today.'

performers.name: DeMario Douglas
performers.note: Led the team in catches and posted the second 100-yard game of his career.

performers.name: Corey Kiner
performers.note: Took over the backfield after Stevenson's knee injury, with TreVeyon Henderson already out ill.

oppLine: Jordan Love threw for 372 yards and three touchdowns and ran for another; Christian Watson had 171 receiving yards and Matthew Golden 164, each with a touchdown.
